title: The Pot and the Lid
summary: A young groom complained to Nasruddin that his bride was spirited and argumentative....
full_text:
A young groom complained to Nasruddin that his bride was spirited and argumentative.

Nasruddin brought out an iron cooking pot and its heavy curved lid: "When the soup boils, the lid rattles; but without the lid, the soup boils away into steam. Let the lid rattle, and the feast will be savory!"
moral: Every kettle finds its matching lid; partnership thrives on mutual understanding.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach readers?
options: Patience, honesty, and humility lead to lasting harmony
quiz.hint: Think about how justice and truth prevail.
